native_build.scope: Native backend must be explicitly prebuilt; compilation is excluded from all timings
native_build.compiler_note: Available compiler is recorded for reproducibility; this does not independently attest which compiler produced a pre-existing binary

methodology.filesystem_cache: Warm: preflight parses the input and hashing reads source/input files before measurements; no filesystem cache flush
methodology.original: Complete unmodified AST-extracted compute_data with original file/date helpers
methodology.direct_fresh: Fresh direct engine, no disk cache: constructor through first compute_data return
methodology.planar_fresh: Fresh planar engine, no disk cache: constructor through first compute_data return
methodology.planar_disk_hit: Fresh planar engine using the already populated temporary persistent cache: constructor through first compute_data return
methodology.direct_warm_different_day: One complete query on an existing direct engine after an untimed query for a distinct date; no disk cache
methodology.planar_warm_different_day: One complete query on an existing planar engine after an untimed query for a distinct date; no disk cache
methodology.planar_cli_disk_hit: Wall time for a fresh Python process with explicit --method planar and --cache-dir, including imports, startup, cache loading, calculation, JSON output, process exit and parent JSON parsing
methodology.cache_creation: Separately timed constructor and first planar query into an empty temporary cache; includes input parsing and geometry preparation; compared to the first timed original for the same date
methodology.cache_scope: TemporaryDirectory is cleaned after all trials; disk files hold prepared data/geometry, never completed daily results; no user cache paths appear in report
methodology.order: Rotate start among the seven cases by repetition index; cache creation and every trial run sequentially with no concurrent jobs started by the benchmark
methodology.native_build: Explicit prebuild is required and excluded from all timings; cache creation loads the prebuilt native library before trials
methodology.exactness: Every complete returned [depths, split, displacement] list must equal the same-repeat original exactly; CLI date also checked; signed zeros compare equal
methodology.diagram_validation: This latency benchmark checks complete returned scores; run compare_daily.py --validation-only --method planar separately for full daily diagram validation
methodology.speedup_scope: Original ratios use the in-process original median; the CLI ratio additionally includes its documented process/startup/JSON overhead. Planar-versus-direct ratios compare matching fresh or warm in-process scopes
methodology.exit_requirement: All repetitions, cache creation, original repeat consistency, input immutability and source immutability must pass

validation.reference: Existing extended construction with prepared daily arrays and geometry
validation.candidate: DailyAnalyzer.analyze using the selected persistence method and reused caches
validation.cache_scope: Fresh planar analyzer using numeric disk entries populated by a separate analyzer; all 181 days calculated, no result cache
